recordedBy: Claude (implementer). This record states a ruling it did not make and could not make.
whyThisIsASeparateRecord: The 17-criterion acceptance matrix is a snapshot regenerated at head fd55bac on 2026-08-19 and states Criterion 15 as still remaining. It is left exactly as it was rather than edited in place, because rewriting a dated snapshot would destroy the record of what was true when it was written. This document supersedes its C15 row; it does not replace the matrix.

authenticationWording.why: The ChatGPT connector is set to No Auth at the MCP-client layer only. Every call still crosses an authenticated personal ChatGPT workspace, an explicitly associated Secure MCP Tunnel, that tunnel's minimum-scope runtime credential, a loopback-only MCP endpoint, and the installation-owned ProjectOS bridge bearer credential, before meeting ProjectOS's own authority enforcement.
authenticationWording.ownerConsent: Established when Murad explicitly created and enabled the private connector.

connector.privacyBasis: No publish or share affordance was observed on the connector, and it is absent from the public listing. No explicit visibility flag was read: the connector-detail API returned 404. Recorded as observation, not as a field value.

readOnlyInvocation.acceptanceCriteriaCount: The connector correctly declined to invent a number, because it was not exposed by the available read-only view.

oauth.reason: Not required under this bounded single-owner configuration.

conditionalLimitation: This acceptance holds only while the connector remains private, unpublished, single-owner, in a single-user workspace, and bounded by the existing ProjectOS authority surface. If it is later published, shared, made multi-user, moved across workspaces, or materially expanded in authority, OAuth or an equivalent per-user authorization boundary must be reconsidered.
negativeEvidenceRetained: c15-oauth-discovery-failure.json — automatic discovery failed against the tunnel-derived resource identifier
c15-manual-oauth-failure.json — manual Advanced OAuth values were not consulted by ChatGPT's validation
c15-connector-blocked.json — workspace/plan mismatches that blocked earlier attempts
These are kept deliberately. The route that did not work is part of why the accepted route is understood.

infrastructureRetained.note: Retirement is a separate owner-authorised decision. Nothing has been deleted or revoked.
